items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: I used to play with this guy named Sadik Hakim... he would use me, because I would go play with him a lot

ctx.x: Okay. I used to play with this guy named Sadik Hakim, which his real name was Argonne Thornton, he used to play with Bird. He was a kid when he played with Bird. He lived with Bird, he wasn’t that good, he was learning how to play. He wasn’t Bud Powell, but Bird let him play when Hakim did a record with Bird and Argonne now is grown up and I moved to New York and he befriended me. Okay? He was an older black guy, a great piano player at that time.
